maddeler.e:
نتجامل (form VI)
# نَتَجَامَلُ (natajāmalu) /na.ta.d͡ʒaː.ma.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَجَامَلَ (tajāmala)
# نَتَجَامَلَ (natajāmala) /na.ta.d͡ʒaː.ma.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَجَامَلَ (tajāmala)
# نَتَجَامَلْ (natajāmal) /na.ta.d͡ʒaː.mal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَجَامَلَ (tajāmala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
